pairs: In the days of one of the judges,
there was a famine in the land.
And a man from Bethlehem in Judah departed to sojourn in the region of the Moabites with his wife
ut peregrinaretur in regione Moabitide cum uxore sua ac duobus liberis.
And entering into the region of the Moabites,
Et mortuus est Elimelech maritus Noëmi:
And Elimelech the husband of Naomi died;
and she remained with her sons.
They took wives from among the Moabites,
of whom one was called Orpah,
And they lived there ten years.
remansitque mulier orbata duobus liberis ac marito.
and the woman was left alone, bereaved of her two children and her husband.
Et surrexit ut in patriam pergeret cum utraque nuru sua de regione Moabitide:
And she arose so that she might journey to her native land, with both her daughters-in-law,
audierat enim quod respexisset Dominus populum suum, et dedisset eis escas.
from the region of the Moabites. For she had heard that the Lord had provided for his people and had given them food.
Egressa est itaque de loco peregrinationis suæ, cum utraque nuru:
And so she departed from the place of her sojourn, with both her daughters-in-law,
et jam in via revertendi posita in terram Juda,
and having set out upon the way, she was about to return to the land of Judah.
“Go to the home of your mother.
May the Lord deal mercifully with you,
just as you have dealt with the dead
Det vobis invenire requiem in domibus virorum quos sortituræ estis.
May he grant you to find rest in the houses of the husbands, whom you will obtain by lot.”
They lifted up their voice, and began to weep,
“We will journey with you to your people.”
num ultra habeo filios in utero meo,
Do I have any more sons in my womb,
ut viros ex me sperare possitis?
so that you could hope for husbands from me?
For I am now exhausted by old age,
and not fit for the bond of marriage.
Even if I were to conceive on this night,
si eos expectare velitis donec crescant,
if you were willing to wait until they were grown
and had completed the years of adolescence,
you would be elderly before you could marry.
quia vestra angustia magis me premit,
For your difficulties weigh upon me greatly,
et egressa est manus Domini contra me.
and the hand of the Lord has been set against me.”
they lifted up their voice and began to weep again.
En reversa est cognata tua ad populum suum,
“See, your kinswoman returns to her people,
Ne adverseris mihi ut relinquam te
as if I would abandon you and go away;
I also will stay with you.
and your God is my God.
Whichever land will receive you dying,
in the same I will die,
and there I will have the place of my burial.
May God cause these things to happen to me,
si non sola mors me et te separaverit.
if anything except death alone should separate you and I.”
Videns ergo Noëmi quod obstinato animo Ruth decrevisset secum pergere, adversari noluit, nec ad suos ultra reditum persuadere:

Therefore, Naomi saw that Ruth, being firmly resolved in her soul, was determined to go with her, and that she was unwilling to be dissuaded, and that nothing further could convince her to return to her own.
And so they set out together,
When they had entered the city,
the news quickly spread among them all.
quia amaritudine valde replevit me Omnipotens.
For the Almighty has greatly filled me with bitterness.
Egressa sum plena, et vacuam reduxit me Dominus.
I went out full and the Lord led me back empty.
So then, why call me Naomi,
quam Dominus humiliavit, et afflixit Omnipotens?
whom the Lord has humbled and the Almighty has afflicted?”
Venit ergo Noëmi cum Ruth Moabitide nuru sua,
Therefore, Naomi went with Ruth, the Moabite,
her daughter-in-law, from the land of her sojourn,
ac reversa est in Bethlehem, quando primum hordea metebantur.
and returned to Bethlehem, at the time of the first reaping of the barley.
